final: WITH patient_avgs AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) AS patient_avg FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(patient_avg) AS overall_avg FROM patient_avgs), kept AS (SELECT p.ID, p.patient_avg, p.patient_avg - o.overall_avg AS diff_overall FROM patient_avgs p CROSS JOIN overall_avg o WHERE p.patient_avg > o.overall_avg), kept_avg AS (SELECT AVG(patient_avg) AS kept_avg FROM kept) SELECT k.ID, k.patient_avg, k.diff_overall, k.patient_avg - a.kept_avg AS diff_kept_avg FROM kept k CROSS JOIN kept_avg a WHERE a.kept_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff_kept_avg DESC LIMIT 10
